svg.aria-label: rosetta: many agents, one history, on your machine
svg.title: rosetta: many agents, one history, on your machine
svg.desc: Three planes, one above another. The lowest is a slab cut into tiles, the stores that coding agents write, some as lines and some as tables. The middle one is the ledger, a row of segments with the last still open: what is kept. The top one is one history in a single script: what you read. A line rises from one store through the ledger to a row of the history. Many formats in, one vocabulary out.
